lifetimes.scope: G1/G2/G3 on scores exchangeable with the frozen warm pool, anchored controller

lifetimes.why: the score population is a legacy stream, not the anchored closed-loop one; a changed score/selection contract starts a new confidence lifetime, so the certified event does not carry over

rule: A change to base-pool bytes, predictor bytes, score/selection contract, or deployment epoch starts a new confidence lifetime. Appending scores inside one unchanged epoch does not. Anything reported under a new lifetime without recalibration is diagnostic, never certified.
